name: Noto Bond (CSD notary + Regulator)
tagline: Private bond — notary & counterparties see amounts; a Regulator oversees via a Pente group
concept: A Noto bond with the CSD as notary, run in hooks mode. Policy executes in a Pente privacy group {CSD, Regulator}, mirroring balances as a private ERC-20. So the Regulator sees every position without ever being a counterparty — while the banks see only their own coins. A plain consortium member sees only opaque, indistinguishable Pente-group transitions (mint and transfer look identical, and even the on-chain notary is the Pente group, not the CSD). The public sees nothing.

consortium.name: Consortium member
consortium.role: On the chain · not a bond party, not in the group

steps.title: CSD forms the oversight group & issues the bond (hooks mode)
steps.plain: The CSD and Regulator form a Pente privacy group. The CSD deploys the bond as a Noto token whose policy runs in that group via hooks (a private ERC-20 tracker), so the Regulator can oversee every move.

steps.title: CSD mints 1,000 BOND to Bank A
steps.plain: The notary and recipient (Bank A) see the coin; the onMint hook records it in the Pente tracker, so the Regulator sees the position too — without holding anything.
steps.tech: bond.mint({ to: bankA, amount: 1000 })  ·  onMint → tracker._mint(bankA, 1000)

steps.title: Bank A transfers 300 BOND to Bank B
steps.plain: Bank A (sender), Bank B (receiver) and the notary see the amount; the onTransfer hook updates the tracker, so the Regulator sees both new positions. Other consortium members see only the masked tx; the public sees nothing.
steps.tech: bond.transfer({ to: bankB, amount: 300 })  ·  onTransfer → tracker._transfer(bankA, bankB, 300)

facts.title: Notary = CSD
facts.detail: co-signs every move · known to participants, not to outside observers
